transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we discussed, I'm ready to make the final approval on the early-payment discount program — 2% discount for suppliers who opt in to be paid 30 days before invoice maturity, funded from operating cash, reviewed quarterly. Before I sign off on the operating terms, I need final desk updates from each of you: risk, accounts payable, tax, and legal. Please go ahead with your updates.

transcript.text: Before I give my full risk desk update, I need to flag something important from the exposure review I completed this morning. Our internal working-capital policy permits no more than $1,500,000 of eligible early-payment invoices from any one supplier. Since the current proposal would allow all approved suppliers to participate with no single-supplier cap, we'll need to address that before the program can go live.
